label: An actual root's absence has an admitted reason only if some nature excludes it
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every actual concrete root r at w and every determination d that r lacks at w, if the arena admits some reason at w for the fact lack r d (EXPLAINED_ABSENCE_1), then some ESSENCE_6 condition on r's profile fails at every set of determinations that contains r's real determinations together with d (an essential exclusion of d). It does not say that the reason is that condition. Rationale: a root has no actual concrete ground, so whatever counts as a reason why it lacks d does so because some nature excludes d. A bare negative clause 'lacks d' in the root's nature satisfies it, as does an admissibility condition that excludes d.
